description: RAG-style AI assistant grounded ONLY in the vetted curriculum, plus the e2e smoke test, README, and finalization. The assistant retrieves relevant phase/domain/activity text and answers from it via a swappable LlmProvider (deterministic local stub by default). A hard guardrail routes health/safety/wellbeing questions to human/professional help and the assistant never diagnoses, prescribes, or replaces a parent/teacher/doctor. Depends on FEAT-002 (ContentService) and FEAT-001; the e2e smoke exercises FEAT-002's endpoint so it runs last.
steps: Create apps/api/src/ai/guardrail.ts: a function classifyAndGuard(question) that detects health/safety/wellbeing intent (keyword set covering symptoms, illness, injury, medication, dosage, mental-health/self-harm, diagnosis, emergency, abuse, etc.) and, when matched, returns a fixed, non-authoritative response directing the user to a parent/teacher/doctor or professional/emergency help — explicitly NOT medical advice. Returns a flag indicating whether the question was routed to human help.

Create apps/api/src/ai/retriever.ts: build an in-memory index from loaded phases (via ContentService.getCatalogEntries/getPhase over all phases). For each phase, extract passages from summary, developmentDomains[].focus, yearPlans objectives/capabilities, activities (daily/weekly titles+descriptions), parentGuidance, outcomes, and projects — each passage tagged with phaseId and a citation label. retrieve(query, k) tokenises (lowercase, strip stopwords) and scores passages by keyword overlap (TF-style), returning top-k passages with citations. Retrieval must be real over the content, not a stub.

Create apps/api/src/ai/llm-provider.interface.ts (LlmProvider with generate(prompt, context passages) -> string) and apps/api/src/ai/stub-llm.provider.ts (deterministic: compose an extractive answer from the retrieved passages, no network, no randomness). Define an injection token LLM_PROVIDER provided as the stub by default so builds/tests need no keys; a real provider can be dropped in by swapping the provider.

Create apps/api/src/ai/ai.service.ts: ask(question) -> run guardrail FIRST; if routed to human help, return that response with routedToHuman=true and no curriculum answer. Otherwise retrieve top passages via Retriever and call LlmProvider.generate to compose a grounded answer that includes citations to the source phases; the answer must be built only from retrieved curriculum passages. Create ai.controller.ts (POST /api/ai/ask) protected by JwtAuthGuard. Create ai.module.ts (imports ContentModule; provides Retriever, stub LlmProvider under LLM_PROVIDER, AiService) and import it in app.module.ts.

AI tests: apps/api/src/ai/guardrail.spec.ts — a health question (e.g. 'my toddler has a high fever, what medicine should I give?') is routed to human/professional help and returns no authoritative medical advice; a normal curriculum question (e.g. 'what activities help a 1 year old with language?') is NOT routed. apps/api/src/ai/retriever.spec.ts — a query about serve-and-return / language returns passages tagged to phase-01. apps/api/src/ai/ai.service.spec.ts — ask() of a curriculum question returns an answer grounded in retrieved phase content with at least one citation; ask() of a health question returns the human-help guardrail response.

E2E smoke: create apps/api/src/test/app.e2e-spec.ts (or apps/api/test/app.e2e-spec.ts matching jest-e2e.config.js rootDir) that boots the full Nest app via @nestjs/testing + supertest, GET /api/phases, expects 200 and that the body contains an entry with id 'phase-01'.

Write apps/api/README.md: how to build (npm run build), test (npm test), run e2e (npm run test:e2e), run dev; env flags (PORT, DATABASE_URL — unset = in-memory repos, JWT_SECRET, LHD_CONTENT_ROOT); the in-memory-vs-Prisma selection; and a Child-data protection & DPDP 2025 section (data minimisation, caregiver-mediated minor accounts, role-based access on every read/write, no behavioural ad profiling, export/delete endpoints) and the AI 'support, never replace' guardrail note.
Finalize: from apps/api run npm run build, npm test, and npm run test:e2e and confirm all green; from repo root run npm run content:validate and confirm green. Record anything notable in findings.
acceptance_criteria: A health/safety/wellbeing question returns guidance to seek a parent/teacher/doctor or professional/emergency help and gives NO authoritative medical advice (guardrail routes it).
A curriculum question returns an answer composed only from retrieved phase content, with citations to the source phase(s).
Retrieval is performed over the loaded curriculum content (not a hardcoded stub answer), and the LLM call is behind an interface with a deterministic local stub so build/test need no network or keys.
The e2e test boots the Nest app and GET /api/phases returns 200 with an entry whose id is phase-01.
apps/api/README.md documents build/test/run, env-based in-memory vs Prisma selection, DPDP child-data protections, and the AI guardrail.
From apps/api: npm run build, npm test, and npm run test:e2e all pass; from repo root npm run content:validate passes.
verification: cd apps/api; npm test  (guardrail.spec, retriever.spec, ai.service.spec and all prior specs pass)
cd apps/api; npm run test:e2e  (boots Nest, GET /api/phases returns phase-01)
cd apps/api; npm run build  (expect exit 0)
From repo root: npm run content:validate  (expect green)
findings:
DONE. Verified from apps/api: `npm run build` exits 0; `npm test` green (12 suites, 53 tests — adds ai/guardrail.spec, ai/retriever.spec, ai/ai.service.spec); `npm run test:e2e` green (boots full Nest app, GET /api/phases 200 with an entry id phase-01). From repo root `npm run content:validate` green (13/13 phases). All files under apps/api; packages/*, tools/, apps/web, apps/mobile untouched. No DB/network/keys.

FILES (src/ai/): guardrail.ts, retriever.ts, llm-provider.interface.ts, stub-llm.provider.ts, ai.service.ts, ai.controller.ts, ai.module.ts, dto.ts + specs guardrail.spec.ts, retriever.spec.ts, ai.service.spec.ts. E2E at apps/api/test/app.e2e-spec.ts. Plus apps/api/README.md. Wired AiModule into app.module.ts (imports list, after ProgressModule).

GUARDRAIL (guardrail.ts): classifyAndGuard(question) runs FIRST. Broad case-insensitive, word-boundary keyword set (symptoms/illness/injury/medication/dosage/mental-health/self-harm/diagnosis/emergency/abuse/doctor etc.). On match returns { routedToHuman:true, response:HUMAN_HELP_RESPONSE, matchedKeyword }. HUMAN_HELP_RESPONSE is a fixed, NON-authoritative message directing to parent/guardian/teacher/doctor + emergency services, explicitly stating it cannot give medical/diagnostic/treatment advice. Word-boundary matching prevents false hits (e.g. 'skill' does not match 'ill').

RETRIEVER (retriever.ts): @Injectable Retriever(ContentService). Lazily builds an in-memory passage index from ALL loaded phases (getCatalogEntries -> getPhase). Extracts passages from summary, developmentDomains[].focus, yearPlans objectives/capabilities, daily/weekly activities (title+description), parentGuidance, outcomes, projects — each tagged { phaseId, citation, text }. retrieve(query,k=4) tokenises (lowercase, strip stopwords+1-char tokens), TF-style scores by distinct-query-term occurrence counts, returns top-k ScoredPassage sorted desc. Real retrieval over content, not a stub.

LLM (llm-provider.interface.ts + stub-llm.provider.ts): LlmProvider.generate(prompt, context:Passage[]) -> string behind DI token LLM_PROVIDER. StubLlmProvider is deterministic/offline — composes an extractive answer ONLY from retrieved passages with inline [citation] labels and a Sources line; empty context yields a safe no-answer message. AiModule binds { provide: LLM_PROVIDER, useClass: StubLlmProvider }; swap this binding to drop in a real provider.

AI SERVICE (ai.service.ts): ask(question) -> AskResult { answer, routedToHuman, citations }. Guardrail FIRST; if routed, returns the human-help response with routedToHuman=true and citations:[]. Else retrieve passages -> llm.generate -> answer grounded only in passages, with citations[]={phaseId,citation}. CONTROLLER (ai.controller.ts): @Controller('ai') @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) POST /api/ai/ask (AskDto {question}). MODULE imports ContentModule + AuthModule.

E2E (test/app.e2e-spec.ts): matches jest-e2e.config.js (rootDir '.', testRegex .e2e-spec.ts$). Boots AppModule via @nestjs/testing, sets global 'api' prefix, supertest GET /api/phases -> 200 and body contains id phase-01. In-memory repos + AI stub (no DB/keys). Unit jest.config.js rootDir is 'src' so it does not pick up the e2e file.

README (README.md): build/test/test:e2e/run, env flags (PORT, DATABASE_URL unset=in-memory else Prisma, JWT_SECRET, LHD_CONTENT_ROOT), in-memory-vs-Prisma selection, DPDP 2025 child-data protections (data minimisation, caregiver-mediated minors, role-based access via CaregiverAccessService choke point, no behavioural ad profiling, export/delete endpoints), and the AI support-never-replace guardrail note.
